env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# SPEC 2.1: only an unexported const map adds no heap bytes at init. The
# package-level variable of an exported const map holds a built map.
cd m
go run gen.go
logos build -o $WORK/bin/pexp$GOEXE ./pexp
logos build -o $WORK/bin/phid$GOEXE ./phid

exec $WORK/bin/pexp$GOEXE
stdout '^ok exported-values$'
stdout '^ok exported-init-grows$'
exec $WORK/bin/pexp$GOEXE
stdout '^ok exported-init-grows$'
exec $WORK/bin/pexp$GOEXE
stdout '^ok exported-init-grows$'
exec $WORK/bin/pexp$GOEXE
stdout '^ok exported-init-grows$'
exec $WORK/bin/pexp$GOEXE
stdout '^ok exported-init-grows$'

exec $WORK/bin/phid$GOEXE
stdout '^ok unexported-values$'
stdout '^ok unexported-init-flat$'
exec $WORK/bin/phid$GOEXE
stdout '^ok unexported-init-flat$'
exec $WORK/bin/phid$GOEXE
stdout '^ok unexported-init-flat$'
exec $WORK/bin/phid$GOEXE
stdout '^ok unexported-init-flat$'
exec $WORK/bin/phid$GOEXE
stdout '^ok unexported-init-flat$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/cmexport

go 1.27

-- m/gen.go --
//go:build ignore

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

func table(pkg, name string) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "package %s\n\nimport _ \"example.com/cmexport/h0\"\n\nconst %s = map[int]int{\n", pkg, name)
	for k := 0; k < 1000; k++ {
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\t%d: %d,\n", k, k*k)
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "}\n\nfunc Get(k int) int {\n\treturn %s[k] ?? -1\n}\n", name)
	return b.String()
}

func write(dir, file, text string) {
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(dir+"/"+file, []byte(text), 0o644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

func main() {
	write("exp", "exp.lgo", table("exp", "Squares"))
	write("hid", "hid.lgo", table("hid", "squares"))
}

-- m/h0/h0.lgo --
package h0

import (
	_ "fmt"
	_ "logos/rt"
	_ "os"
	"runtime"
)

var AtInit uint64

func init() {
	var m runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&m)
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&m)
	AtInit = m.HeapAlloc
}

-- m/pexp/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"runtime"

	"example.com/cmexport/exp"
	"example.com/cmexport/h0"
)

const minGrowth = 16000

func main() {
	var m runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&m)
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&m)
	grew := int64(m.HeapAlloc) - int64(h0.AtInit)
	if len(exp.Squares) != 1000 || (exp.Squares[31] ?? -1) != 961 || (exp.Squares[999] ?? -1) != 998001 || exp.Get(31) != 961 {
		fmt.Println("FAIL exported-values")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("ok exported-values")
	if grew < minGrowth {
		fmt.Printf("FAIL exported-init-grows: heap grew %d bytes, want at least %d\n", grew, minGrowth)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("ok exported-init-grows")
}

-- m/phid/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"runtime"

	"example.com/cmexport/h0"
	"example.com/cmexport/hid"
)

const maxGrowth = 1024

func main() {
	var m runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&m)
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&m)
	grew := int64(m.HeapAlloc) - int64(h0.AtInit)
	if hid.Get(31) != 961 || hid.Get(999) != 998001 || hid.Get(1000) != -1 {
		fmt.Println("FAIL unexported-values")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("ok unexported-values")
	if grew > maxGrowth {
		fmt.Printf("FAIL unexported-init-flat: heap grew %d bytes, want at most %d\n", grew, maxGrowth)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("ok unexported-init-flat")
}
